signal.method: Design brief (§12.2) sets the admissible set — electric cyan or hot magenta. Catalogue hue occupancy picks between them. Taste bounds the search; data chooses inside it.
signal.why_not_unconstrained: The globally emptiest bin is acid green, which §12.2 lists among the deliberately avoided treatments. Recorded rather than silently discarded.
